books.title: Mystic Love
books.author: John Butler
books.description: Forty years of John Butler's letters to Christine, written after a vision of spiritual unity at 47 and through long years of living alone. The letters follow unreturned love, loneliness and loss as they slowly give way to a sense of oneness. He offers it as a book of hope for anyone grieving, bereaved or longing for love.

courses.title: Mystic Love (audiobook)
courses.description: The full text of Mystic Love read by John Butler himself, about 34 hours in all, delivered as a download through the BookFunnel app. The letters trace a lifetime of love, loss and loneliness opening into spiritual union.
